{{Quote|Very well, then, and you can inform your mercantile-class sponsors that I gave you this direct order: you may arrest Bohhuah Mutdah, I haven't the power to stop you. But you will return him to me, alive and in condition to stand trial in the Oseon, or I'll have you plucked, dressed, and roasted for Founder's Day. '''Founder's Day''' was a [[holiday]] celebrated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Smoothie" /> In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' to [[6 BBY]].</ref> [[Senior administrator/Legends|Senior Administrator]] [[Lob Doluff]] threatened to roast [[Waywa Fybot]], of the avian [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Species/Legends|species]], for Founder's Day if he failed to capture the wealthy [[Lesai/Legends|lesai]] addict [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]].<ref name="Smoothie" />

==Behind the scenes==
Founder's Day was mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', written by [[L. Neil Smith]] as the second volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures]]'' series.<ref name="Smoothie" />
